articles.summary: Partnership marks a first for the United Center and establishes RYTHM, Inc. as the venue’s Official THC Sponsor ROLLING MEADOWS, Ill., Jan. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- The largest live entertainment venue in the United States is making history as the first major arena to offer THC beverages.
articles.title: Señorita and RYTHM Make History as the First THC Beverages Available at a Major U.S. Arena
